title: Remove General Framework Imports From Sketchpad
description: Make sure that sketchpad imports no general framework. Only semio-elements/ui must import all ui-related libraries. Only leave sketchpad specific dependencies. Re-export everything needed from elements/ui.
summary: Removed all general framework imports from sketchpad. All UI and framework libraries (dnd-kit, radix-ui, react-three, xstate, xyflow, react-router, react-i18next, react-hotkeys-hook, three.js, yjs, date-fns, fuse.js, dagre, MDX) are now re-exported from @semio-elements/ui. Sketchpad only keeps sketchpad-specific dependencies: @semio/js, sql.js, react, react-dom. Added Framework Re-exports region to elements.tsx with organized sub-regions. Cleaned sketchpad package.json from ~60 deps down to 5. All type-checks pass, vite build succeeds.
